QUOTE: `StdioTransport::stderr_reader_loop` (`src/mcp/transport_stdio.cpp:164`) | Drains child stderr | `close()` closes the fds and then joins the thread. ... `SSETransport::sse_reader_loop` (`src/mcp/transport_sse.cpp:107`) | Reads the SSE stream

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names a stderr reader thread for the stdio transport and an SSE stream reader thread for the SSE transport, each spawned in its own transport file.
